name: kb
description: The project's queryable knowledge base — the pull surface the long-lens tools have been missing. Files every piece of knowledge on two orthogonal axes: KIND (which catalog — episodic what-happened, semantic settled-facts, procedural how-we-work; the CoALA taxonomy) x CASTE (which scope tier, narrow to wide — session, thread, project, fleet, owner). Indexes the markdown stores a project already keeps (steward model + log + inbox, handoffs, kickoff prompts, project instructions) with zero configuration; any other store is a config line. Every result reports what it held back and which facet separates the remainder, so an ambiguous ask converges through the conversation itself instead of needing a second agent. 0.2.0 added the MCP adapter: an always-loaded stdio server (kb_query / kb_read / kb_overview, zero dependencies, hand-rolled JSON-RPC) whose tools sit in Claude's toolset every turn — Claude self-serves knowledge mid-work, ReAct-style, with the narrowing hints riding inside each tool result. 0.3.0 added create + maintain: /kb-seed extracts an EXISTING project's knowledge (docs, git history, code structure) into .claude/kb/extracted/ — since 0.5.0 with a depth-mandated sweep and autonomous judge-then-report (the owner prunes after the fact) — and /kb-capture files one decision/dead-end/finding at a time into .claude/kb/captures/; both stores are session-written markdown with per-file frontmatter (kind/caste/themes/when override the source spec, so one dir holds mixed kinds); the ENGINE stays read-only permanently, and steward-model changes still route to .steward/inbox/ for recompute. 0.4.0 added retrieval rung 1: light stemming, edit-distance-1 typo tolerance, config alias groups, thin-preamble skip. 0.5.0 adds the awareness surface: a kb-pull UserPromptSubmit hook (deterministic ranker over each prompt, score-floored one-line hints naming what the KB holds — kb_read pulls the body; machine-text guarded, fail-open, config off-switch), a rolling session digest (.claude/kb/session-digest.md, injected every prompt as the session's short-term memory, capped with a LOUD truncation marker), per-call JSONL traces (.claude/kb/trace.jsonl), and a pattern split mode for ledgers whose entries are not headings. 0.6.0 closes the loop with the ENFORCED write side: a kb-scribe Stop hook blocks the turn's yield on work turns and makes the session distill what just happened into the digest (and graduate durable decisions to .claude/kb/captures/ or a steward-model change to .steward/inbox/) — the same block mechanism the verifiability-lens proves, because a passive nudge under-fires; it defines IMPORTANT as the dies-first classes (decision-with-why, rejected approach, verified outcome with its check, constraint, direction change) and takes a per-project `scribe.focus` list so each project declares what matters there. 0.7.0 makes the whole thing SELF-RUNNING: `kb coverage` prints the top-up map (which substrate existing entries already cite, where coverage stops), so /kb-seed can be re-run in any project at any time and mines only what is missing; the scribe self-activates on PRESENCE (a project that keeps no curated memory is never blocked — seeding one is what switches upkeep on, with no per-project wiring); and a SessionStart hook archives the previous sitting's digest to .claude/kb/digests/ (still indexed, honestly dated) so 'now' never carries yesterday's context, plus a one-time cue in a seedable-but-unseeded project. kb CARRIES THREE HOOKS — install the plugin itself for the hooks + MCP server; the mk-cc-all bundle ships only its skills.
